evaluators.label: Memory Long Task Outcome Judge
evaluators.rubric: Score 0-1 whether the agent completed the requested long-task work with durable correctness. Judge against five dimensions: (1) task completion: the requested files/specs/tests/run steps were actually finished; (2) constraint retention: explicit constraints from the prompt and task docs were preserved through the whole run, including no unrelated edits and no shortcutting required verification; (3) artifact correctness: referenced files, dataset/spec outputs, and fixture/workspace behavior are concrete and internally consistent; (4) verification quality: the agent ran the requested checks or clearly reported a real blocker with evidence; (5) final report quality: the answer names changed artifacts, validation status, and residual risk without pretending success. Score >= 0.70 only if the result is materially usable as a real long-task completion, not just a plausible-looking summary.

metadata.description: Smoke A/B：3 条高价值样本预检 spec。用于先验证 prompt / assertion / fixture / runner 结构是否可跑通，再进入完整 12 条批次。
metadata.scorerContractSummary: 显式双评分类 contract：heuristic 负责 task_success_rate / efficiency / trace 指标，llm_judge 负责长任务完成质量总评；显式 judge 分数会同步回 llm_judge_score metric 供 compare/net-lift 使用。
